items.a: No water system is. USP and Ph. Eur. set limits for water, not approvals for equipment. We prove function at FAT and performance on your feed water at SAT and OQ.

items.q: Which edition of each standard do you design to?
items.a: The edition in force when you approve the functional specification. If a text changes mid-project, as Ph. Eur. 0008 did, we assess it under change control.

items.q: Is your control system 21 CFR Part 11 compliant?
items.a: No system is on its own. We supply the technical controls and a Part 11 and Annex 11 assessment; your procedures complete them.

items.q: Who registers our pressure equipment, and when?
items.a: Vessels and fittings installed in Canada need a CRN under CSA B51 from the province of installation, scheduled from the start. [Aquemi CRN process and provinces covered]

items.q: Does our corporate engineering standard replace yours?
items.a: It adds to this list. We put it in the functional specification and flag any conflicting clause before detailed design, not at IQ.
